reason: Add a one-shot early-termination bonus (time_bonus) that pays at termination if the episode ended successfully and ended before a threshold (e.g., 500 steps). This increases the objective_positive_budget without reducing dense rewards or increasing the success_bonus alone. The bonus is event-gated (paid only at termination) and one-shot (paid once per episode). This makes termination relatively more attractive compared to collecting dense rewards, encouraging the policy to land quickly and terminate. The bonus is scaled to be comparable to the success_bonus (50 for early termination, 25 for medium termination) to provide a meaningful incentive without dominating.
preserved_design: one-shot terminal success_bonus (100 at termination if success condition met)
progress-conditioned engine penalties (main_penalty and orientation_penalty conditioned on both_legs_contact)
diagnostic variables (distance_to_pad, vertical_speed, angle_deviation, main_engine_firings, orientation_engine_firings, both_legs_contact, crash_occurred, success_flag)
changed_design: Added time_bonus: one-shot terminal bonus for early termination (50 if episode length < 500, 25 if episode length < 750, 0 otherwise). This is event-gated and one-shot, paid only at termination if success condition met.
required_edits_implemented: Make completion/objective bonuses one-shot or terminal-aligned so they cannot fire every step.
Remove repeatable proxy-success payment modes that can be farmed without episode completion.
Keep dense progress signals bounded and smaller than episode-scale objective signals.
Add diagnostics for success_flag/objective_bonus so post-training audits can verify payment count.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Do not increase raw per-step action or engine bonuses.
Do not let objective_bonus exceed roughly one terminal event per episode.
Do not define success only as a non-terminal state predicate if it pays a large reward repeatedly.
do not increase repeatable per-step bonuses without event/progress gating
Avoid prior rejected pattern: reducing distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward, angle_reward scales.
Avoid prior rejected pattern: increasing success_bonus from 100 to 200 alone.
rejected_patterns_avoided: single_component_dominance: success_bonus remains one-shot, not repeatable.
large_dense_budget: dense rewards are preserved at their current scales; only a one-shot early-termination bonus is added to improve the dense_to_objective_ratio.
action_coverage_plan: All four discrete actions remain available. The revised reward does not change action space. The policy should still use all actions for stabilization and descent. The main change is that the policy is now incentivized to terminate quickly after landing, which may reduce the use of action 0 (do nothing) while hovering on the pad.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_reward (max 0.5) and vertical_speed_reward (max 0.3) still guide descent. Phase 2 (descent): engine penalties remain mild and conditioned on not being landed. Phase 3 (touchdown): success_bonus (100) and time_bonus (up to 50) are now both available at termination, encouraging the policy to complete the episode quickly after landing.
payment_mode_plan: success_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met). time_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met and episode length < threshold). main_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). orientation_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward, angle_reward: per-step but bounded and small relative to objective.

expected_metric_changes.dense_to_objective_ratio: decrease from 0.21 to ~0.15 (early-termination bonus adds to objective budget without changing dense rewards)
expected_metric_changes.success_like_terminal_rate: increase from 0.8 to >0.9 (policy more incentivized to terminate quickly)
expected_metric_changes.episode_length: decrease from 683.2 to ~500-600 (policy terminates sooner to collect early-termination bonus)
expected_metric_changes.generated_reward: increase from 433.47 to ~500-600 (early-termination bonus adds to total reward)

validation_metrics: Static reward validator must not detect repeatable objective_bonus or non-terminal proxy-success farming.
success_flag_mean <= 1.2 (large success payments should not repeat many times per episode)
objective_bonus_mean <= 120.0 (one +100 objective event per episode is the expected scale)
generated_minus_fitness_gap <= 500.0 (generated reward should stay comparable to evaluator fitness)
